notes: Mini female character is now correctly framed and readable from every orbit. Simple flat-color atlas, clean low-poly silhouette, 7-bone rig and no degenerate triangles. Appropriate as a lightweight kids'/prototype human variant alongside realistic humans.
limitations: 512px flat-color atlas rather than PBR maps; intentionally low-poly.
Unused-object/tangent and skinned-mesh warnings are non-visual validator notes.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
